data.description: Modern Style | World Class Amenities Prime Location
data.display_address: Hillmont Residences, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Hillmont Residences is an Ellington residential complex located in Jumeirah Village Circle. A building with an elegant design of 12 floors, embodying modern life against the background of a rounded terrain. For sale are studios and spacious apartments with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. The interiors are designed in a modern style with delicate shades, which creates a cozy atmosphere. All residences have balconies. Panoramic windows are filled with sunlight, which visually expands the space and offers spectacular views of urban landscapes.

Residents are provided with premium world-class amenities: a gym with state-of-the-art fitness equipment and pilates machines, a swimming pool with a relaxation area, a children's pool, a children's area, and a clubhouse. A concierge service is available on site. Within walking distance are shopping centers, schools, kindergartens, medical institutions, cafes, restaurants and retail outlets.

The JVC area has an excellent location, which allows residents of Hillmont Residences to quickly reach key points in Dubai. Circle Mall is a 7-minute drive away, while Dubai Hills Golf Club is a 15 — minute drive away. Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Marina Mall, Emirates Mall and Jumeirah Beach are just a 20-minute drive away. Business Bay, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 25 minutes ' drive away, while Dubai International Airport is a 30 — minute drive away.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
